text:
alex: Heads up — noticed an uptick in failed TLS handshakes for eu-west ingress services around 09:12 UTC. Failures correlate with recent RBAC tightening (svc-account: cert-provisioner) we rolled out at 08:50. Logs show KMS unwrap deny for certain cert requests.

marta: @alex can you paste the exact log lines / audit IDs?

alex: paste from edge-proxy logs: 
```
2026-03-23T09:12:05Z edge-proxy[ingress-eu-west] WARN tls: handshake failed id=8f7a3a reason=client_hello_no_sni
2026-03-23T09:12:06Z edge-proxy[ingress-eu-west] ERROR cert-manager: request failed id=8f7a3a k8s_event="secret not found" apiserver_err=403
2026-03-23T09:12:07Z kms-client[eu-west] ERROR unwrap: AccessDenied org_id=redwood-team trace_id=trx-20260323-09:12:07
```

leo: From audit logs I can see the KMS IAM principal used by cert-provisioner got its decrypt permission removed by the RBAC change. Audit entry: `audit: change=role-modify actor=infra-bot target=role/cert-provisioner time=2026-03-23T08:49:32Z`.

jamie: Oof. That matches. The RBAC patch was meant to restrict list/secrets get but looks like it accidentally removed kms:Decrypt binding in the cross-account role.

marta: Can we confirm scope — is this only eu-west or global?

alex: Failures observed only in eu-west gateway pods. Other regions OK. cert-provisioner in eu-west is using a different role binding (region-specific).

leo: Quick mitigation: re-add kms:Decrypt to the region role. I can patch the IAM binding, but we need approval from sec before touching infra-bot changes. Also need to record the remediation in audit.

jamie: Approve. Re-adding limited decrypt for `role/cert-provisioner-eu-west` while we triage. Make sure to add a restrictive condition: `ResourceTag=region:eu-west` and `RequestIp` constraint if possible.

alex: If someone can run the patch, let's do a canary on a single ingress pod first. Prefer to avoid full rollout until we confirm cert issuance is back to normal.

leo: I'll run the IAM patch and redeploy one cert-provisioner pod to pick up creds. Command I plan to run: 
```bash
# add decrypt permission to role
gcloud iam roles update role/cert-provisioner-eu-west --add-permissions=kms.cryptoKeyVersions.useToDecrypt
kubectl rollout restart deployment/cert-provisioner -n platform --selector=region=eu-west
```

marta: Log the exact commands and put a guard in case the redeploy increases failure rate. Also capture the kube events and KMS audit entries (trace_id).

oncall-bot: incident-note created: incident/2026-03-23-eu-west-cert-unwrap (severity:medium) — runbook: cert-unwrap-degrad.

jamie: After we restore decrypt, let's add a postmortem checklist: 1) tighten IaC to prevent role drift, 2) add unit test in RBAC CI that simulates cert requests, 3) add an alert that ties KMS unwrap denies to ingress error rate.

alex: Agreed. Also adding a short-term fallback: allow proxy to serve cached certs for 10m to cover rollout window. Patch snippet for proxy config: 
```yaml
proxy:
  tls_cache_ttl: 10m
  allow_stale_on_kms_fail: true
```

leo: Patch applied, redeployed single pod at 09:28 UTC. Monitoring now.

alex: Handshake error rate is dropping on that pod. KMS unwrap trace shows success for trace_id=trx-20260323-09:28:43.

marta: Great. Proceed to roll the rest of cert-provisioner replicas. Documenting changes in infra PR and referencing the incident note.

jamie: For long-term fix: let's add a static integration test in CI that creates a short-lived cert and validates decrypt perms in each region's role. Assigning to infra:leo.

leo: Will open ticket INFRA-4123 and include remediation steps + required policy condition.

alex: Thanks team. Closing interim operations — will keep monitoring for 2 hours and then mark incident as resolved. :thumbsup:
